svg.title: Lyapunov certificate audit
svg.desc: Three panels compare a tailored Lyapunov metric with Euclidean transient growth, show LaSalle energy decay for a damped oscillator, and locate the explicit Euler stability boundary.
svg.text: A · 非正规系统：欧氏量可增，P-能量严格降
B · LaSalle：Ė=0 的点不一定停住
final state norm = 0.03062; largest invariant subset is (0,0)
C · 同一连续流，不同步长得到相反结论
ΔV = ½h(h−2)x²; strict decay iff 0 < h < 2
